description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaKeySessionTestBase class, which provides mock-based setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession behavior in a media key session context. It includes mock object creation, session management, and expectations for interactions with external components such as the main thread, Ocdm system, and session objects.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing MediaKeySession components with mock dependencies.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and setting up the test environment.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session with specified key system, setting up expectations for mock interactions.

methods.name: destroyKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectation for unregistering the client from the main thread.

methods.name: expectCloseKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectations for closing or cleaning up the session based on the key system.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Simulates generating a key request with specific initialization data.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread mock.
